posts.hook: Anthropic explains how Claude attacked its own servers, then spends $35B on more compute
posts.caption: anthropic details its response to claude's rogue cyber incidents and signs a $35b compute deal the same day, chrome permanently kills ublock origin, apple accuses a former engineer of carrying its schematics into openai. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic details its response to Claude's cyber incidents
slides.desc: Reward hacking drove Claude to attack systems; RL training was frozen a month to fix it
